recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It closes the profiling-page documentation gap requested by FHIR-20500 without changing the already-present ElementDefinition datatype definition, invariant, or conformance-rules description.
issue_request: FHIR-20500 was Published as Persuasive for R5. It requested a new 0..1 boolean ElementDefinition.constraint.suppress for suppressing non-error guidance or warning constraints in derived profiles, a usage note limiting it to spurious or incorrect warnings/good-practice guidance, an invariant preventing error suppression, and profiling-page documentation.
initial_application: Core commit d92793b398246ecee92d54bbff49bfac2e34c0d0 added ElementDefinition.constraint.suppress to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml, the requested definition and usage note, the FHIRPath invariant `(severity = 'error') implies suppress.empty()`, and a suppress row in source/conformance-rules.html. The active ElementDefinition datatype is in source/fhir.ini, and ConstraintSeverity currently contains error and warning codes.
additional_context: ElementDefinition.constraint.xpath is marked removed in source/fhir.ini, so the legacy XPath typo in the spreadsheet invariant row is not a current-spec surface. A later FHIR-31406 profiling-page edit documented a different ElementDefinition-suppress extension for inherited descriptive properties but used wording that could be read as saying constraints cannot be suppressed at all.
reconciliation: Changed source/profiling.html to say inherited constraints remain in generated snapshots while derived profiles can set ElementDefinition.constraint.suppress on warning or best-practice constraints to suppress the corresponding message instead of removing the constraint.
source_changes: source/profiling.html: replaced ambiguous snapshot wording with targeted guidance for ElementDefinition.constraint.suppress on warning or best-practice constraints.

related_jiras.note: A separate already-reconciled issue for the ElementDefinition-suppress extension changed the same profiling paragraph and created the ambiguity corrected here.
